title: Chapter 279
text:
Han Xiao said in a playful tone, "Compared to the pollution you have caused in the past and in the future, I think cutting down this tree is more environmentally friendly."

In his previous life, no player had ever found out the origin of the leader. It was indeed difficult to find the true identity of a missing normal person in this chaotic era. After listening to the leader's story, Han Xiao had a clearer understanding of him.

The leader was a staunch patriot. He was one of the few Gollan people who had luckily escaped Raylan's invasion. In order to obtain the power to take revenge, he took the initiative to seek a breakthrough at the edge of life and death. He grew from an ordinary person to one of the top supers on the planet.

Now that he had no other choice, he would rather die than live in dishonor. It could be seen that the hatred had been branded in his bones and was very strong.

The experiences of the planet's protagonists are indeed very legendary. Every protagonist-type character has a story that can be dug deeper, Han Xiao thought to himself.

When he was still very weak, the leader was like a mountain in front of him. Han Xiao had no choice but to operate carefully and become stronger. Finally, he had the strength to face the enemy head-on and destroy the Germinal Organization.

The Germinal Organization was the main antagonist of Planet Aquamarine in Version 1.0. Han Xiao had participated in this main storyline as a player in his previous life, but now that his identity had changed, he had played a huge role in it. The experience was completely different. Although Han Xiao appeared very calm (mainly to prevent joy from turning into sorrow), it did not mean that he did not enjoy the fruits of victory. He still felt a sense of accomplishment.

The leader shook his head and said, "I didn't expect that an escaped test subject would become the biggest enemy. In fact, when you stole the secrets and broke through my ambush, I knew that the Germinal Organization would definitely lose. I don't have the habit of waiting for death, but there's nothing I can do. It's just a final struggle."

Because he had a premonition, no matter how bad the situation was, the leader was not surprised. He watched the organization that he had built slide into the abyss step by step with his own eyes. There were mixed feelings in his calm.

"To me, defeat means death. The Six Nations want to see me surrender. They want to receive all the secret knowledge that the Germinal Organization has accumulated over the years … I will not let them get anything."

Han Xiao raised his eyebrows. "Speaking of which, I heard that you've captured quite a number of hostages. If you detonate them, they're dead for sure. Furthermore, the nuclear explosion will affect the climate and worsen the natural environment of Blue Star. It's not good for the future of humanity. Are you sure you want to do this?"

The leader fell silent. Only the sound of heavy breathing could be heard from the speakers. Han Xiao was not in a hurry. He stared at the screen calmly.

After a while, the leader spoke in a deep voice.

"You want to persuade me to surrender?"

Han Xiao shrugged. "That's not my intention. You don't look like someone who would listen to advice, but the person opposite me wants me to do so …"

At this time, Han Technician was in the meeting room of Sanctuary One, sitting on the sofa with a tablet in his hand. Bennett sat opposite him and listened to the whole process, constantly gesturing for Han Xiao to persuade the leader. Bennett did not want to see the result of both sides losing.

Han Xiao felt that Bennett was being naughty. If the leader had originally planned to surrender, he might have changed his mind the moment he saw him. Fortunately, the leader had been firm from the beginning, or else he would have been a little scared … Wait a minute, this logic felt weird.

Bennett was waving his hands in front of him. Han Xiao had no choice but to try. He did not want Bennett to spoil him like an old mother.

"I'd rather drag everyone down with me …" The leader's tone was cold. "I want the world to feel pain!"

Han Xiao opened his mouth, but a curse was stuck in his throat.

What the f * ck, is that you?

The leader sneered. "I hate this world. Why do I have to think about it? Even if the Six Nations win, don't think they won't pay the price! The Six Nations are all executioners deep in their bones. They destroyed countless countries before they finally reached where they are today. They are standing on the ruins and singing praises to themselves. The winner is the king, and the loser is the bandit. Those blood debts will be buried by history, and no one will know or investigate. No one will seek justice for the old era. The surviving regimes have been free and unfettered for too long. It's time for them to pay back some interest! "

The leader did not care about what the world would become. He did not care about the flood after his death. He would rather betray the world than let the world betray him. Even a normal person would think this way, not to mention the leader.

Han Xiao did not comment. The consequences of nuclear weapons would not affect him much. He would leave Blue Star sooner or later, and the next version would be the Mutation Disaster. An even bigger disaster would come sooner or later. Compared to that, this climate disaster was nothing.

In his previous life, the Germinal Organization was at death's door, and there was a hidden danger of a comeback. Now, it was eliminated once and for all, but it would bring about negative consequences in the future. He did not know which result was better, but the latter would obviously allow him to complete the Grade A main storyline mission [Dust of the Fallen Seeds] in one step.

For the other Blue Star people who did not know, the latter result was the most frightening. The climate and environment were closely related to their lives, and no one wanted the environment to worsen. Bennett, who was sitting opposite him, looked anxious. He could not wait to fly to the Germinal Organization headquarters and kill the leader before he triggered the button.

Han Xiao looked at the clock and said slowly, "There's still some time before the deadline of the Six Nations, right? Don't you want to stay a little longer?"

"I prefer to decide my own death date." The leader's eyes were firm. He reached out to hold the nuclear launch key and started to turn it slowly.

A suffocating pressure spread through the screen. The leader's movements seemed to be infinitely long. Bennett grabbed the sofa's armrest so tightly that he tore the leather.

Every time the key turned, a second passed on the countdown timer of countless lives.

The second hand slowly pointed to the final result.

Han Xiao looked at the leader's face quietly. Suddenly, he said, "I never knew your name."

"My name?"

The leader raised the corner of his mouth and revealed a ferocious smile. He said lightly, "Not important."

"… That's true. Then … goodbye." Han Xiao sighed and waved his hand.

The key turned to 180 degrees.

A faint vibration sound came from the screen. It was the sound of the missile taking off.

The leader retracted his hand and sat motionless on the chair like a statue. At this moment, there was no hatred in his tone. There was no regret or sadness of dying. There was no intense emotion. It was as calm as old neighbors saying goodbye to each other at dusk and returning home for dinner. He nodded at Han Xiao.

"Goodbye."

…

"Warning, warning, a high-speed moving object has taken off from the Germinal Organization headquarters!"

All the officers in the Six Nations' war room suddenly stood up in shock and anger. This was the worst outcome that they had expected. Although everyone was mentally prepared, when this moment arrived, they all found it hard to accept.

The nuclear explosion would kill the hostages and cause pollution. The Germinal Organization headquarters would be razed to the ground. Countless secret technologies would be lost forever.

"Do we launch the anti-missile?" The adjutant's voice was trembling.

All the officers had no choice. Without hesitation, they all agreed. "Launch it immediately!"

In the Germinal Organization headquarters, the ground and buildings were shaking slightly. The hidden Germinal Organization soldiers looked up at the sky through the windows. Their eyes reflected the missiles taking off one after another.

The atmosphere was dead silent. Everyone understood the leader's decision and knew what was going to happen next.

Crying, despair, madness, convulsions, trembling, howling, roaring, numbness …

All kinds of emotions before destruction.

In the distant horizon, densely packed black objects were rapidly approaching. Some of them collided with the missiles midway, while others landed on the headquarter base group.

Buzz!

The first sound was a high-frequency explosion that could not be recognized by the human ear. Most of the people in the Six Nations' base covered their ears as blood flowed out from their ears.

A pillar of fire with a diameter of tens of kilometers soared into the sky. The base group instantly disintegrated in the fire. Dark smoke and dust spewed out from the dazzling fire, slowly condensing and rising, slowly turning into a dense black mushroom. It was an extremely spectacular sight.

In the Six Nations' base far away, there was no room for anything else in the eyes of the people looking at it. There was only a vast expanse of white. The strong light temporarily blinded most of them. Even the Supers could not help but close their eyes. No one could maintain their natural state in this destructive aura. Everyone felt small, as if they had become sand that was about to be swept away by the wind. They could not control their own destiny, and their bodies began to tremble uncontrollably.

Even further away, the end of the horizon could be seen. A spear-like fire pierced through the thick clouds that had been accumulating above the Germinal Organization headquarters all year long. The clouds became a hollow ring, and the sea of clouds dispersed.

Then, the fire expanded a second time, and a yellow, circular blast wave mixed with dust burst out. Wherever it passed, the ground cracked, and countless buildings and metal pieces were mixed in the dust. Countless twisted iron pieces more than ten meters in size were thrown more than ten kilometers away by the explosion as if they were lighter than a baseball, like feathers, and fell to the ground in the wilderness like rain.

The shockwave finally swept across the camp, and an earth-shattering force surged over. It was like the breath of the Wind God. The tents flew up like dandelion seeds, and the heavy vehicles were flipped over like rubber balls. Needless to say, the people were fine. Even if they broke bones, it was only a minor injury. The surrounding players were shocked and excited. They hurriedly recorded this scene, afraid that they would miss anything.

Following the shockwave was a second explosion. The frequency could be captured by the human ear, and it was almost enough to break eardrums.

Boom! Boom!

The sound was like the sky was falling!

Deafening!

The base at the back gradually stabilized, and the troops quickly retreated far away.

Only the fire that kept rising in the wilderness was left. The scene was like a punishment from the heavens. The rolling mushroom cloud was like the grin of the devil, constantly changing and twisting its shape.

The leader, with his unfinished ideals and the organization that he had created, turned into a bright firework that lit up the world.

The Germinal Organization had typed GG.

The nuclear explosion that leveled the headquarters to the ground was the last sound of the Blue Star War.

…

The highest level of the Six Nations held an emergency meeting. The enemy was gone, but the aftermath was not optimistic.

"According to the scale of the explosion, the weather bureau has constructed a calculation model. The first batch of radioactive dust will enter the atmospheric cycle in the next three to six hours. In the next month, the continent of Andrea will enter a nuclear winter state that will last for at least half a year. It is not suitable for any creatures to survive. A large number of plants and animals will die on the land, completely turning it into a land of death. The radiation will affect the coastal area of Andrea, which may cause the collapse of the marine food chain. Some marine creatures may also undergo unknown mutations.

"The high concentration of radiation and pollutants will enter the ocean cycle and spread to the entire world through rain. This process will take about 300 to 500 days to complete. Then, the global climate will start to worsen. Because of the large scale, the degree of deterioration will not be as severe as Andrea, but it will still cause serious damage to the atmosphere. It will affect the whole body and cause negative effects in all aspects. This effect will last for more than ten years. During this period of time, it is estimated that the level of civilization will not improve, and it may even regress …"

The upper echelons of the Six Nations had serious expressions. This was not just a matter of one country, but a matter of the entire world and the entire race.

An anti-war upper echelon slammed the table and said angrily, "Look, look! What did you do! Our troops suffered heavy losses, and we did not get any benefits after the victory. This even led to such an outcome. We should not have gone on an expedition, we should not have started a war! It would have been better to let the Germinal Organization hide in Andrea. They should have quit while they were ahead after destroying their base! "

When they decided to go on an expedition, some of the politicians were anti-war because once the war started, resources and speaking rights would be tilted toward the military. Some of the upper echelons were naturally unhappy, but the minority obeyed the majority, and their voices were ignored. Now, they had a legitimate reason to jump out and speak righteously after the fact.

"At this point, let's not talk nonsense. It's better to end the pain quickly than to prolong the pain."

The bitter consequences of the war had to be borne by the entire world, and it affected many innocent people. In order to get rid of this huge problem, many of the upper echelons asked themselves if it was really worth it.

In the end, the answer was yes.

At least in the eyes of the upper echelons, a huge enemy was more threatening than the so-called global meteorological disaster. Only by getting rid of this huge problem could they be at ease and not have to worry about it anymore. Only then could they have the conditions to develop steadily. The upper echelons of the various countries felt that everyone had to face the threat of the meteorological disaster and spend national resources to deal with it. They were still on the same starting line, which was fair to everyone.

Fortunately, the result was not irreparable. If it was polluted, they could deal with it later. That was life.

"Should we block the news from the public?"

"There are too many people who know about it. There's no need to. Let's announce it officially."

"The public will definitely protest and blame us for causing this result."

"It's not important. Anyway, the war is over. What we have to face now is the follow-up disaster. Let everyone know that we are in the same situation. We should put aside the past and not think about who is right and who is wrong. We should work together to get through this."

"Then, should we …"

The upper echelons of the various countries discussed one suggestion after another.

…

Bennett's face was pale. He paced back and forth in the room, muttering 'too much' and 'crazy' to himself. Han Xiao sat on the sofa with his legs crossed, looked at the blue sky outside the window, and shook his head.

The leader pressed the final note and turned the headquarters into ashes.

The Germinal Organization could be said to be the first big boss that he had faced, and it was destroyed by his hands. One of the main storyline of Blue Star had been destroyed by him. Han Xiao kind of liked this feeling.

No matter how legendary the leader's deeds were, he was still his enemy. Han Xiao was not soft-hearted toward his enemies. A win was a win, and there was no need for the winner to feel sorry for himself.

You have received Planet Legendary Point — [Germinal Organization Buried]!

Grade A Main Storyline Mission [Fall of the Seeds] completed!

Grade: Unbelievable

You have received [Unbelievable] Grade Mission Reward.
